thread.title: Blue Chips Lead Market; 2 Dow Stocks Retake 50-Day Line

author: PAUL WHITFIELD
title: Blue Chips Lead Market; 2 Dow Stocks Retake 50-Day Line
text:
U.S. stocks indexes rose after the opening bell Monday, as blue chips led the way.
The blue-chip Dow Jones industrial average rushed 0.8% higher, while the Nasdaq and the S&P 500 added 0.6% and 0.5%, respectively. The small-cap Russell 2000 lagged with a 0.2% gain.
X Volume in the stock market today was higher on both major exchanges compared with the same time Friday.
In the 30-component Dow, almost half the stocks are trading under their 50-day moving average lines. On Monday morning, 3M ( MMM ) popped 1.7% as it retook its 50-day line. Pfizer ( PFE ) surged 1.4%, also retaking its 50-day line.
The 50-day line is a crucial area where bulls like to see support develop.

Analysts expect both 3M and Pfizer to step up earnings growth in 2018.
Among the four FANG stocks plus Apple ( AAPL ), each stock rose in fast trade. Facebook ( FB ) was up 1%. Amazon.com ( AMZN ) rose 1.2%. Netflix ( NFLX ) added 2.3%. Alphabet ( GOOGL ) advanced 0.7%.
Meanwhile, in an interview with CNBC, Warren Buffett said the corporate tax cuts will act as a "huge tailwind" for U.S. businesses.
Economic News The Chicago Fed National Activity Index for January fell short of expectations. The consensus view called for 0.2. The actual figure was 0.12. A reading above zero points to growth above trend. A reading below zero points to growth below trend. The Chicago gauge is national in scope.
New home sales for January missed expectations.
